Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely asserted that “the organization that recognized his title is the World Boxing Hall of Fame,” conflating the sanctioning body (IBF) with a Hall of Fame and naming the wrong Hall. The correct larger Hall of Fame recognizing the IBF is the International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF).
